page.layout: One page of text; the right edge is cut off by the scan, so the lines run into the margin. Running head at top. Main text in full width: a Latin heading and paragraph, a set of Latin verses in italic, then a second heading and a verse paragraph below. No marginal notes visible.

main_text.p: In Pontis triplicis aquæductum, Gardi flumini inter duos montes, nulla tant artificis addita inscriptione, impos tum, tertio à Nemauso miliari.

p.i: MOntibus impositos cantauit Gracia monte Pyramidum ostentat, barbara Memph opus: Plus est quod cernis, triplicis coniungere pontis Fornicibus, montes sic potuisse duos. Et plus est (vidtam quo se natura fatetur) Impositiffe ipsis flumina fluminibus. Et rursum hoc plus est, contempto laudis honore Artificem nomen subticuisse suum: Mire opifex, quod tu fecisti, sit licet ingens, Quod non fecisti, plus ego miror opus.

main_text.head: In linguæ Latinæ à ROBERT STEPHANO patre, & Græcæ a HENRICO STEPHANO filio, collectos & editos thesauros.

p.i: AV sonias quondam Musas Robertus egent Excepit grato prouidus hospitio. At nunc Henricus, patris vestigia sectans, Errantes Graias excepit hospitio: Illa autem memores accepti muneris, ecce AEternas Stephanus constituere domos.

page.notes: Lines cut off at the right edge of the scan; partial words there are completed only where clearly implied, and the text is given as far as legible. Several words in the verses are doubtful, notably "vidtam", "Memph", and "Avsonias" (printed "Avfonias"). The running head and page number are not clearly printed; a small mark at the foot right is probably a signature or stray mark and is omitted.
